boundary: Four sequential independent authenticated SSH connections in ABBA order (112,160,160,112 KiB/s total). Each uses matching client and cloud budgets, 20 idle + 20 loaded + 20 recovery samples. Real streamed cat, repeated fixed payloads with SHA-256 verification. No agent input. All blocks complete. Background live traffic uncontrolled; neither same-connection randomization nor UI scrolling acceptance.

provenance.baseline: 557ee01; total112/bulk96 KiB/s; diagnostic cloud broker directory isolated as traffic-budget112-probe to avoid sharing production traffic-v2 budget
provenance.candidate: ad8c138 code; total160/bulk128 KiB/s; cloud binary built before commit from 557ee01 plus the exact committed patch; diagnostic Mac source exported from 557ee01 with the identical scheduler.go change

client.evidence: User reported location and provider in this session

provenance.clock: Mac UTC timestamps, monotonic durations; no cross-host clock subtraction

server.evidence: GCP inventory checked at approximately 12:04 UTC; runtime placement not re-resolved in each block

provenance.settings: Both variants: 16 KiB socket window, dynamic terminal window 8-64 KiB, TCP backlog feedback default-off, 2 KiB burst. Dynamic window derives from each variant's rate.
provenance.workload: profile-ssh-latency -load-mode command -samples20; repeated 349539-byte verified cat payloads; fresh command streams within one resident connection per block

runs.boundary: One authenticated Go SSH connection; exact resident ping, equal-size guest echo and gateway keepalive. Load runs cat through the production resident command adapter, verifies binary stdin/stdout SHA-256 and requires successful exit status. verified_load_bytes counts received bytes; verified_upload_bytes counts matching uploaded bytes. No claim of Mutagen or installed-daemon coverage.
